sloka: अपिते चरणौ मूर्ध्ना स्पृशाम्येष प्रसीद मे ।किमिदम् चिन्तितम् पापे त्वया परमदारुणम् ॥२-१२-१५॥
transliteration: apite caraṇau mūrdhnā spṛśāmyeṣa prasīda me ।kimidam cintitam pāpe tvayā paramadāruṇam ॥2-12-15॥

translations.english: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.
